text: The Escambia County School District in Florida pulled Merriam-Webster's Elementary Dictionary from school libraries and placed it in storage for review. The district said the dictionary might violate HB 1069, a law signed in May 2023 concerning books that depict or describe sexual conduct. It was one of more than 2800 books pulled from Escambia County school libraries and placed into storage.
